description: Takes what the agent said it did and compares it with what the machine shows. Returns four separate buckets: confirmed (claimed and observed), contradicted (claimed but nothing changed), unreported (changed and never mentioned), and unverifiable (claims a filesystem and git record cannot settle, such as 'the tests pass' or 'the bug is fixed'). The buckets are never merged, because a claim is not evidence.

claimedPaths.description: The files the agent said it changed. Absolute or workspace-relative.

claimedStatements.description: Everything else the agent asserted, in its own words. These are returned as unverifiable by design.

ignore.description: Extra directory names to skip, matched on a single path segment.

maxFileBytes.description: Do not hash files larger than this. Default 8388608.

maxFiles.description: Stop the walk after this many files. Default 50000.

noDefaultIgnores.description: Also scan .git, node_modules and .murphy. Off by default.

root.description: Absolute path to the workspace to observe. Use the project root the agent is working in.

name: check_claims
title: Hold an agent account against the observed record
